title: In the US, half of training and development specialists earned less than US$69,280 in May 2025
subtitle: Annual wages at the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile, US, May 2025: the two occupations closest to instructional design and the manager role above
notes: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) has no occupation called instructional designer. Instructional designers are counted inside broader occupations, mainly these two.
Figures are wages for employees from the BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics survey, May 2025. They exclude the self-employed.
